notes.title: Pumpkin Lootbox Update
notes.notes:
[h1]A new event lootbox is available for the rest of October[/h1]

The drop timer has always been a hot topic. On 9/12 we changed it from every 30 minutes to 1 hour, which was a good move at the time. In addition to the 1000 online players, there were close to 10000 bots using scripts to trigger drops without opening the game.

Since then, we've implemented a new mechanic that requires you to spend 1 minute in game before you can obtain a drop, which caused a massive decline in the number of bots (they refunded the game to avoid having to pay for it). Because of this, we feel comfortable changing drops back from every 1 hour to 30 minutes.

[list]
[*] The drop rate has been changed back to 30 minutes
[*] The Rubber Duck has been removed from Briefcases
[*] The Golden Autoclicker has been removed from Golden Briefcases
[*] Briefcases have been replaced with Pumpkin Lootboxes in the default drops
[*] Briefcases will return to the default drops next month
